title: DesktopSpeaker internal CAD v13 (board RT-3 + models-v13 accurate models)

source.models: ai-files/cad/models-v13/3d/ (board models via the project library, enclosure models read directly)

frame.cad: X right (long side), Y depth (0 = front outer face, + = rear), Z up (0 = outer bottom of the box)
frame.front: +z in glTF (front baffle at z = 0, rear lid outer face at z = -206.6)
frame.ground: feet bottoms at y = -15, box bottom at y = 0

pcb.units: mm (root node PCB_<board> carries scale 1000 on the KiCad metre data)

transform.note: already applied in the file: load both files unchanged and they overlay

pcb.content: kicad-cli pcb export glb --subst-models --include-pads --include-soldermask --include-silkscreen; components by reference designator

pcb_copper.content: tracks + zones (outer layers) of the partially routed RT-3 board, same frame; optional layer: load on demand (not counted in the 40 MB budget)

viewer_notes: Plain glTF 2.0, no extensions (three.js r128 GLTFLoader).
Materials are doubleSided so clipped sections show inner faces.
Explode: add node.userData.explode_mm (mesh nodes in enclosure.glb) to node.position; move the pcb.glb root by [0, 60, 0].

Per-node provenance is in node extras (userData): model_source, accuracy (<0.5mm = compared with a drawing/standard in the models-v13 audit | estimated = known deviation or placeholder for an unselected part | unverified = no drawing), accuracy_note.
Soldermask and silkscreen materials are translucent (alpha 0.83 / 0.9, alphaMode BLEND).

groups.description: Printed main shell: front baffle, walls, driver pads, square woofer seat with 4 outside insert bosses, lid bosses, feet bosses, battery cradle, encoder knob dish
Printed rear lid 4 mm: USB-C, 2 jacks, SW100, rocker cutouts; gasket groove
Printed sealed woofer chamber insert (partition, walls, roof, PCB shelf, PCB screw bosses); bonded into the shell
Two Dayton Audio ND65-4 full-range drivers (maker STEP)
Tang Band W3-2052SC down-firing woofer (models-v13: square 82.55 frame, 68.25 square hole pattern, factory 3.3 mm gasket; seller data + photo estimates)
2P Samsung INR21700-50S pack (models-v13, datasheet max 21.25 x 70.62) + PCM board placeholder (cradle is printed in the shell)
Schematic cable runs: J5 to pack, J11 to woofer through the grommet
ISO 4762 screws, Ruthex M3x5.7 inserts, Wurth hex spacers and foot studs (models-v13), rubber discs, lid gasket, grommet
Encoder knob stand-in (not selected), SW101 CW GRB112B802BR1 rocker (models-v13), front and woofer perforated grilles

pcb_group.description: Board RT-3 (placement R10, partial routing) with the models-v13 corrected library models (J1, J5, J9-J11, SW100, TP1-TP27, U1 offset, U2, U24)

unverified_why.L200: XAL7070 KiCad library model; Coilcraft drawing blocked
unverified_why.TP23-TP27: Keystone 5010-5014: envelope from distributor data, no maker drawing

accuracy_audit.summary: 340 of 346 physical board parts have a model within 0.5 mm of the datasheet; 6 unverified (L200, TP23, TP24, TP25, TP26, TP27)
accuracy_audit.verified_means: passives at class level (thickness codes from MPN/family datasheets); IC body envelopes vs the maker package drawing (nominal); leads sliced at board level vs pads (0.1 mm)

footprint_errors.error: front NPTH locating pegs at x -5.75, drawing -4.75 (1.0 mm off): the jack cannot seat as drawn
footprint_errors.fix: move both front NPTH (+-5.0) from x -5.75 to x -4.75 in PJ-307.kicad_mod and on the board

footprint_errors.error: GND pad 56 (1.78 sq) at local x +1.40, datasheet +4.77 (3.37 mm off); pad 57 correct

outer pads +-1.50 x 0.9 vs TE lands +-1.225 x 0.75; peg holes 1.5 from the pad row on the side away from the edge (TE 0.9, actuator side); bracket pads 1.2 x 1.3 at x +-1.2..2.5 missing; as drawn the actuator tip is 2.30 mm inside the board edge (6.80 mm behind the lid outer face)
footprint_errors.fix: redraw from TE drawing C1 p.1 with the actuator at the board edge

footprint_errors.error: part EEHZA1E101XP is case D8 (6.3 x 7.7) on an 8x10 land; terminals overlap the pads 2.4 of 3.0 mm

accuracy_audit.footprint_errors_note: Modelled as drawn by the footprint (not fixed in v13); the coordinator fixes the footprints on the routed board.

fit_findings.title: Woofer seat redesigned for the real Tang Band W3-2052SC (square frame, 68.25 square holes)
fit_findings.detail: v12 round 86 ring pad, 83.4 x 1.0 flange recess and 77 mm bolt circle removed. The square 82.55 frame with its factory 3.3 mm foam gasket now seats directly on the floor inner face (z 3.0); aperture 76.2 kept; sealing land 3.18 mm on the flats (gasket inner 73.7 overhangs the aperture). Holes at r 48.26 (68.25 square): pilot edge 8.16 mm from the aperture (v12 pilots broke 1.6 mm into it), hole edge 5.45 mm from the frame edge. Inserts (Ruthex M3x5.7, pilot 4.0 x 6.7) sit in four teardrop bosses 4.7 mm below the outer floor (1.0 mm skin, chamber stays sealed; 45 deg point toward the baffle for support-free printing). Woofer grille 90 -> 86 (1.26 mm to the bosses). Magnet top z 50.75, 3.25 mm under the roof; frame 14.94 mm from the partition, 11.94 mm from the lid, 16.73 mm from the side walls.

fit_findings.title: Woofer screws: M3x20 gives only 3.4-4.4 mm thread in the 5.7 mm insert
fit_findings.detail: Stack: head on the frame back (z 19.60) through the 13.3 frame block and the 3.3 gasket. M3x20 engages 3.4 mm with the gasket free, 4.4 mm with 1 mm compression (1.1-1.5 d; tip 2.3 mm above the pilot floor). Raising the seat to fit longer screws pushes the magnet into the roof (3.25 mm left). Options: accept M3x20 (gasket compresses), or M3x22 (DIN 912; 5.4-6.4 mm, still inside the 6.7 pilot) if the owner can source it. Frame thickness and gasket are photo estimates (+-1.5): measure before printing.

fit_findings.title: Woofer chamber volume: front-air correction and chamber lengthened 11.2 mm
fit_findings.detail: The real woofer displaces 0.103 L (v12 stand-in 0.045). v13 also excludes the 0.020 L of air in front of the cone (gasket and frame opening, open to the outside), which v12 counted as chamber air (the v12 hollow stand-in cone made its 0.525 L nearer 0.485 L, estimate). Displacement parameter 0.056 -> 0.1224 L: chamber length 98.2 -> 109.4 mm, partition front face Y 101.39 -> 90.17, net 0.525 L (gross 0.627). Main chamber net 2.025 -> 1.962 L (target >= 0.8). Woofer centre Y 151.50 -> 149.38 (offset +1.5 from mid-chamber, was -2.0) so the H2 PCB-screw boss stays 2.88 mm from the magnet cup (it touched by 2.2 mm3 at the old offset).

fit_findings.title: SW100 actuator does not reach the lid (draft footprint)
fit_findings.detail: With the TE 1977066-1 model on the footprint as drawn, the actuator (dia 2.0, axis 1.70 above the board top) ends 2.30 mm inside the board edge: 2.80 mm short of the lid inner face and 6.80 mm behind the lid outer face. The 5.0 lid bore (radial 1.5) only allows pressing with a pin. v12 assumed a stand-in plunger reaching into the lid. Fix in the footprint correction (actuator at the board edge: then 4.5 mm behind the outer face) and/or add a printed plunger in the lid.

fit_findings.title: Footprint errors exposed by the accurate models (modelled as drawn, not fixed here)
fit_findings.detail: J2/J3 PJ-307 front NPTH pegs 1.0 mm off (jack cannot seat); U1 BM83 GND pad 56 misplaced 3.37 mm; SW100 TE 1977066-1 DRAFT footprint (pads, pegs on the wrong side, bracket pads missing); C275 D8 can on a CP_Elec_8x10 land (2.4 of 3.0 mm overlap). The coordinator fixes them on the routed board.

fit_findings.title: Rear-lid cutouts still aligned with the accurate connector models
fit_findings.detail: J1 HRO TYPE-C-31-M-12 (stadium shell 8.94 x 3.16, was a 9.1 x 3.36 box): radial margin 1.45 -> 1.53 mm, wall clearance in the lid 1.53. J2/J3 8.5 bores 1.25 mm (unchanged model). SW100 bore centre moved 0.05 mm to the real actuator axis (Z 70.30). SW101 rocker: GRB112 model fits the 20.2 hole (0.2 radial), body 2.65 mm above the board top behind the panel, 22.4 deep, 3.87 mm from J3.

fit_findings.title: New board-part models clear the enclosure
fit_findings.detail: J9-J11 JST VH (10.9 tall, were 10.9 stand-ins) 17.5 mm under the top wall; J5 Micro-Fit (5.57) 1.55 mm from its harness tube (schematic); TP23-TP27 Keystone 5010-5014 (8.31 above the board) 20.1 mm under the top wall, TP27 4.10 mm from the H1 screw head; TP1-TP22 (1.5 high) >= 3.06 mm from the H2 screw head. U2 now 1.85 high (was 2.2), U24 1.1 (was 1.6). U1 moved 0.43 mm by the model offset fix: 6.05 mm from the shell. Tightest parts unchanged: C288/C301 2.00 mm, R209 2.01, R106 2.33 mm to M3x16 screw heads.

fit_findings.title: Cells: Samsung INR21700-50S model at datasheet max
fit_findings.detail: Model 21.25 x 70.62; cradle bay laid out for 70.7 (was 70.2): end stop and PCM moved +0.5 mm in X, 0.08 mm end gap at the PCM, 0.53 mm radial gap in the 22.3 cradle. Cell 1 to the left ND65 7.21 mm, PCM to the right ND65 5.43 mm (>= 3).

fit_findings.title: Hardware swapped for the audited models
fit_findings.detail: 34 screws (19 M3x10, 11 M3x16 from models-v13 STEP; 4 M3x20 generated with the same ISO 4762 geometry), 38 Ruthex M3x5.7 inserts, 11 Wurth 970100321 spacers, 4 Wurth 971120321 studs, GRB112B802BR1 rocker. Their 2.5 mm thread bores overlap the 3.0 mm screws: 49 intended thread-engagement overlaps (new category). Kept parametric (not selected, so not verified): knob D30 x 14, rubber feet 12 x 3, PCM board, lid gasket, grommet.

fit_findings.title: Distance artefact guarded
fit_findings.detail: OCC distToShape returned 0.0 for C244, R235 and R238 vs the woofer harness tube (no common volume; true distance about 40 mm). fit_check.py now falls back to the vertex distance in that case and lists it in fit.json dist_artefacts.

fit_findings.title: KiCad GLB vs STEP export differ for two models (unchanged from v12)
fit_findings.detail: pcb.glb component boxes match the FreeCAD placement within 0.005 mm for J1, J2, J3, J5, J9, J11, SW100, U1, U2, U24, TP1 (TP23 0.11), but SW102 0.77 and C275 1.0 (exporter treats sub-shapes differently).
